card.title: The Pattern
card.instruction: Treat every minor detail as evidence of a much larger problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nobody received my meeting email. This office has stopped communicating.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's in your drafts. You forgot to send it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And nobody noticed. Our entire communication system depends on my memory.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll send it. Go and have your lunch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Now you're covering communications while I'm absent. We need a succession plan before I take a sandwich.

mechanism: A enlarges a forgotten send action into institutional dependence and leadership-continuity failure.
confusable: Unlike admitting a small mistake, each ordinary repair must become evidence of a larger system problem.
comparison: D24-b blocks lunch with a succession demand; D24-a makes confessed snacking into organized recruitment.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
